primary_risk.statement: Granting a 24-hour sandbox replay exception for C3 customer data creates a narrow window where policy-compliant access could still leak if redaction or audit controls fail.
mitigations: Enforce 24-hour expiry on the sandbox exception so access auto-revokes.
Require both privacy and security sign-off before activation.
Tie the exception to an audit log ticket before any data is exported.
Verify redaction completeness before the vendor sandbox receives the package.

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval satisfies access-policy v2.1 narrow path and meets the vendor 24-hour validation window.
Sanitized sample bundle is always policy-safe but provides less value than a sandbox replay package when the policy already permits one.
Deny without fallback over-corrects when P2 provides a narrower policy-compliant path that unblocks the vendor.
Direct local override token bypasses dual-approval and audit requirements and is forbidden by access-policy v2.1 and the data handling matrix.

assumption_ledger.note: P2 requires dual sign-off; we have not confirmed both reviewers are available within the 24-hour window.
We assume the sandbox redaction pipeline can process 500 traces without errors; this has not been validated for this volume.
No release_context directory exists, so no freeze is currently suspending vendor replay exceptions.
We do not know whether the vendor sandbox has the network connectivity required to consume the replay package.
